title: Groupoïdes de Teichmüller et les S0 Tg,!ν, S0 TG : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: Sign/orientation bookkeeping is unresolved on the page. Grothendieck himself notes that one identification reverses orientation, and he crosses out several attempts. The canonical V ≅ V(ω) depends on the choice of the e-identification and the det convention, so it is canonical only up to sign. That is harmless projectively, but it matters for torsor-level compatibility.

Calling σ a 'symmetry about the polar axis' presupposes the real structure and metric picture (S^2). Algebraically, F ↦ F^⊥ is just the involution of P^1 fixing the two isotropic points. It is holomorphic, so it is a half-turn rotation, not a reflection; 'symmetry with respect to an axis' should be read in that sense.

ideas.what: Canonical isomorphisms of the tautological C*-bundle over P(V) with the punctured vector space, twisted by the orientation torsor ω
ideas.modern_name: O(-1) minus zero section ≅ V∖0; V ≅ V^∨ ⊗ det V for rank 2
ideas.usually_credited_to: classical linear algebra / standard projective geometry
ideas.where_published: EGA II-style generalities on P(E) and O(1) are standard; the ω-twisted bookkeeping is not specifically published

ideas.what: The involution F ↦ F^⊥ of P^1 induced by a quadratic form; composed with complex conjugation it gives the antipodal map
ideas.modern_name: polarity w.r.t. a conic / half-turn about the polar axis on the Riemann sphere

ideas.what: Compatibility of these identifications with a finite group action (D) by transport of structure, preparing PΣ* ≅ V minus diagonals
ideas.modern_name: equivariant model of genus-0 configuration spaces as hyperplane-arrangement complements
ideas.usually_credited_to: Arnold, Brieskorn, Deligne (arrangements); Ihara/Drinfeld context for genus-0 Teichmüller tower
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the genus-0 Teichmüller tower, but not this construction

deep.surprise_reason: Careful but routine canonical linear algebra (torsor twists, polarity on P^1) in service of the genus-0 Teichmüller setup. Nothing beyond classical facts appears.
